name: Certificate of Authenticity
summary: Named passive certificate record with semantic details and optional target-owned signature and verification composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Self-contained native certificate article named by its visible contextual title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible contextual heading that names the certificate article.

anatomy.name: artist
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored artist, maker or other attribution without a component-generated prefix.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Optional decorative divider that never conveys record structure alone.

anatomy.name: details
anatomy.description: Optional native description list of target-owned certificate metadata.

anatomy.name: detail
anatomy.description: Repeated direct description-list group containing one target-owned name-value pair.

anatomy.name: detailLabel
anatomy.description: Native description term for one localized metadata name.

anatomy.name: detailValue
anatomy.description: Native description value for one target-owned metadata value.

anatomy.name: signature
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned signature or artist-mark composition; ordinary attribution is not silently relabelled as a signature.

anatomy.name: verification
anatomy.description: Optional native descriptive link rendered only when the target supplies a real certificate-record destination.

anatomy.name: verificationMedia
anatomy.description: Optional target-supplied QR or other verification media inside the descriptive link.

anatomy.name: verificationText
anatomy.description: Visible text that identifies the target-owned certificate-record destination independently of verification media.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Contained certificate whose metadata changes intrinsically between one and two columns.

states.name: default
states.description: Required title with any accepted optional target-owned record composition.

states.name: verificationFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a supplied native certificate-record link.

behavior.name: articleLabelling
behavior.description: Targets render a self-contained native article associated with a target-unique id on its same visible contextual heading; heading rank remains document-owned.

behavior.name: semanticDetails
behavior.description: Targets use native dl, direct grouped dt/dd pairs, preserve meaningful authored order and omit groups without values.

behavior.name: optionalComposition
behavior.description: Every non-title region is independently optional and is omitted completely rather than rendered as an empty wrapper or invented fallback.

behavior.name: targetVerification
behavior.description: Verification is an ordinary descriptive link rendered only from a real target-owned destination. The component does not generate QR services, status, proof, issuer trust or authenticity guarantees.

behavior.name: verificationMediaAlternative
behavior.description: Optional media never carries the only link purpose. Redundant media is hidden from the accessible name when adjacent visible text fully identifies the destination.

behavior.name: intrinsicDetails
behavior.description: The card is contained by its host and the details grid responds to the Certificate's own inline size rather than the page viewport.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, empty, localized, unbroken, right-to-left and zoomed target content remains contained and readable when optional regions or verification media are missing.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Certificate owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, custom key handling, live region, animation, asset, generated QR or network request.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required visible record title used to name the self-contained article; contextual heading level and unique id remain target-owned.

properties.name: artist
properties.description: Optional target-authored artist, maker or other attribution without a component-generated prefix.

properties.name: details
properties.description: Optional ordered target-owned name-value composition using native description-list groups.

properties.name: signature
properties.description: Optional target-owned real signature or artist-mark composition.

properties.name: verification
properties.description: Optional target-owned native link composition with a real destination, descriptive text and optional redundant media.

accessibility: Render a self-contained native article associated with the same visible contextual heading through a target-unique aria-labelledby/id pair.
Use native dl with direct grouped dt/dd pairs for target-owned metadata, preserve meaningful authored order and omit groups without values.
Expose verification only as an ordinary descriptive link with a real target-owned destination and visible purpose; a QR or image must never be the only path.
Hide redundant verification media from the link's accessible name when adjacent visible text already identifies the destination.
Give a supplied verification link visible keyboard focus and preserve native link activation, context menu and copy behavior.
Treat the divider as decorative and retain record meaning without it, media, CSS, JavaScript or external services.
Allow localized, unbroken, right-to-left and 200-percent-zoom content to reflow without horizontal page overflow.
Do not generate verification destinations, QR requests, authenticity status, issuer trust, proof semantics, controlled state, live regions or custom key handling.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/storytelling.css with native article, description-list and link semantics plus intrinsic metadata layout and no runtime.

shopify.notes: Liquid snippet maps current product/metafield facts into localized semantic details and accepts optional explicit target-owned signature and verification inputs without generating a QR or authenticity claim.
